aboutBio.heading: Architecting the Future of High-Performance Mobile
paragraphs: With over 6 years of hands-on mobile engineering, I transform complex business requirements into production-ready Android and Flutter applications. My work spans Android TV, IoT integrations, and cross-platform solutions used by thousands daily.

I specialize in **scalable, maintainable architectures** that handle high-traffic loads without compromising speed or reliability. From reducing thermal-printing latency by 40% to engineering location-based services with 90% accuracy gains — I focus on measurable impact for healthcare, fintech, and gaming platforms.
bulletPoints: **Strategic Optimization**: Achieved 40% thermal printing latency reduction for high-transaction platforms.
**Location Intelligence**: Engineered advanced LBS modules with a 90% accuracy boost in real-world delivery apps.
**Real-Time Ecosystems**: Expert integration of Pusher, Socket.IO, and Unity for seamless interactive experiences.
**Elite Reliability**: Maintaining a consistent 99.9% system uptime and 92% crash-free session average.
